text: Who should text first after the first date? Let's say you just had a first date. You invited her, you chose the place, you paid for it, you did the whole preparation. Should you text her? It was an awesome date afterwards? No. Let her message you first. If you message her first after doing everything, you're coming off like a fan. That kills the vibe. You don't want to be perceived as needy and clingy. If the date went well, an appreciative girl will text you. Thanks, I had a great time. And you can answer that you had a great time too. And what if she doesn't? Well, here's the reality check for you. Unfortunately, it's not that uncommon for girls not to text you after a date. Even if it went well. Like I've said in another video, in the beginning, the initiative often has to come from you. And that's okay. So if you want a second date, you will need to initiate again. But don't text her right away. Not the same night. Not the next day. Wait 2-3 days. Then reach out. Ask her how has she been doing the past few days and ask her out again. That's how you stay confident, intentional and without overchasing.
